model.name: Half-wave dipole
model.description: Thin PEC strip dipole with a centre lumped feed, in free space (PML boundaries).
model.reference: C. A. Balanis, Antenna Theory, 4th ed., ch. 4 and 8 (half-wave dipole, induced EMF)

params.label: Cells across the strip width
params.description: Mesh lines across the strip; 1 puts lines only on the two strip edges

params.label: Thirds rule at the arm ends
params.description: 1: mesh lines 1/3 inside and 2/3 outside each arm end; 0: a line on the end

params.label: Refine the mesh normal to the strip
params.description: 1: the same fine lines as across the strip also in y (normal to the sheet)

params.label: Free-space margin
params.description: Distance from the dipole to the domain edge; 0 = max(lambda(f_min) / 4, 40 mm), plus 8 cells for PML

params.label: Absorbing boundary
params.description: MUR (first-order, cheap) or PML_8 (8-cell perfectly matched layer, placed inside the margin)
